Title: Check close activity flow and confirmation

Step Action: Sign in as a care team member and navigate to PGI & Notes > Activities > Open.
Step Expected: The Open Activities list is displayed.

Step Action: Click the close activity icon on an open activity.
Step Expected: The close activity dialog opens for the selected activity.

Step Action: Attempt to save without selecting a close reason.
Step Expected: The activity is not closed and the required close reason is indicated.

Step Action: Select a close reason and enter the Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The selected reason and Supporting Rationale are entered.

Step Action: Save the close dialog.
Step Expected: The activity is closed and a confirmation notification appears in the top-right corner stating that the activity was successfully closed.

Step Action: Check the Open Activities list.
Step Expected: The closed activity no longer appears in the Open list.

Title: Check closed and voided activity filters and See History

Step Action: From PGI & Notes, open View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs and set Status to Closed.
Step Expected: The list shows closed activities.

Step Action: Expand a closed activity using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Step Action: Set Status to Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The list shows activities voided from Open.

Step Action: Expand a voided activity using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Title: Check Activity History card placement and appearance

Step Action: In View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs, set Status to Closed and click See History for a closed activity.
Step Expected: The Activity History modal opens with the activity card above the search bar and history table.

Step Action: Compare the card's position and styling with the cards in the Intervention and Problem History modals.
Step Expected: The activity card uses the same position and style as those history cards.

Step Action: Close the modal and open See History for a voided activity.
Step Expected: The voided activity's card appears above the search bar and history table with consistent styling.

Step Action: Open Activity History for a closed activity with a category label, priority, title, Start Date, and Due date.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and shows the correct category label
State: and Start Date | Due date. Expanded-only details are hidden.

Step Action: Open Activity History for a voided activity with known activity details.
Step Expected: The collapsed card shows that activity's category label when present

Step Action: Compare each card's details with the corresponding activity card in the Open Activities list.
Step Expected: The displayed activity details match the Open Activities card.

Step Action: Inspect the card for a status or close/void reason.
Step Expected: The card shows neither a status nor a close/void reason; terminal changes appear in the history table.

Title: Check activity card when category label is absent

Step Action: Open Activity History for an activity without a category label.
Step Expected: The collapsed card shows priority
Assigned To: and Start Date | Due date without an empty category label.

Title: Check selected activity card and default state when reopening history

Step Action: Open an activity's history, expand its card, and close the modal.
Step Expected: The modal closes.

Step Action: Reopen the same activity's history.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and shows the selected activity's details.

Step Action: Close the modal and open history for a different activity with different details.
Step Expected: The card and history show the newly selected activity with no stale content from the previous activity.

Title: Check closing and voiding changes in activity history

Step Action: Open history for an activity closed from In Progress with a known close reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table has Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change columns, and records the person who closed the activity and the date and time of closing.

Step Action: Inspect the closing entries in the history table.
Step Expected: The table records Status (In Progress → Closed), Status Reason with the selected close reason, and Supporting Rationale with the saved rationale.

Step Action: Open history for an activity voided from Open with a known void reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table records the person who voided the activity and the date and time of voiding, plus Status (In Progress → Voided), Status Reason with the void reason, and Supporting Rationale.

Title: Check activity changes before and after closing or voiding

Step Action: Use an activity with known changes made before closing or voiding, then open its history.
Step Expected: Each pre-terminal change appears with its changed field and change

Step Action: Inspect the history through the closing or voiding event.
Step Expected: The table includes the changes from creation through the terminal event

Step Action: Attempt to edit the closed or voided activity.
Step Expected: The closed or voided activity cannot be edited.

Step Action: Refresh or reopen its history after the attempted edit.
Step Expected: No changes are recorded after the closing or voiding event.

Title: Check activity history search and column sorting

Step Action: Open Activity History for an activity with known history entries.
Step Expected: The table displays Change Date

Step Action: Search for a value present in the history, then search for a value with no matching entries. Clear the search.
Step Expected: Matching entries appear for the matching search; the existing no-results behavior appears for the unmatched search; clearing the search restores all entries.

Step Action: Sort each sortable column in both supported directions.
Step Expected: The table sorts as it does in the Intervention and Problem History modals without changing row data.

Step Action: Apply a search and sort, then expand and collapse the activity card.
Step Expected: The search text
Assigned To: and sort order are preserved; the search and table remain usable.

Title: Check long activity history scrolling and Close button

Step Action: Open Activity History for an activity with long content and enough history entries to require scrolling.
Step Expected: The card and history remain readable and the modal scrolls when needed.

Step Action: Scroll through the history table.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible.

Step Action: Click Close.
Step Expected: The modal closes and returns to the underlying PGI view.

Step Action: Reopen the modal, expand the card, and scroll through the long history.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible and closes the expanded modal.
